units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:8">Sabb. I, 8</cite> <he>עם השמש</he> with the sun, i.e. as long as the sun shines, before sunset.

<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:4">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ותתנהג עם בניך וכ׳</he> and deal with thy children mercifully.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 23a:16">Snh. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>מי חותם עִמָּהֶן</he> who is to sign as witness with them; a. fr.
